events.author: Solver
events.name: Aspiring General

options.text: We need [character] now, not years later.

events.text: The soldier [character] comes to you, saying he would like to lead the troops in battle one day. [character] believes that training soldiers personally is the best way for a leader to earn their respect. As such, he requests your permission to become the instructor at the Barracks of [city].
